stories.headline: US accuses dozens of countries of helping China avoid Trump’s tariffs
stories.description: White House report claims tens of billions of dollars in annual revenue lost to transshipments.

stories.headline: Wildfires force thousands to flee as blazes spread across Europe
stories.description: At least a dozen people have reportedly been hospitalised in Croatia after blazes tore into the tourist town of Omis.

stories.headline: Japan: Record rains in Chiba kill six people as thousands stranded at Narita Airport
stories.description: The storm cut power to more than 20,000 households and left 7,000 people stranded at Tokyo's Narita airport.

stories.headline: Nigel Farage defeats Count Binface to reclaim UK parliamentary seat
stories.description: The Reform UK leader received 22,239 votes in the Clacton by-election, compared with 9,455 for Binface.

stories.headline: Israel's Christians fear rising harassment after nun attack and spitting incidents
stories.description: Christians in Israel face rising harassment and violence amid ongoing conflicts.
